GRADE 6 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Time: 80 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. This mock paper follows CBC assessment style.
2. Answer all questions.
3. Manage your time carefully.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About My Purpose at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. discuss how they use their God-given talents and abilities,
   B. Learners should ignore My Purpose completely.
   C. My Purpose is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise My Purpose.

2. About My Purpose at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. explain biblical teachings on the use of talents and abilities,
   B. Learners should ignore My Purpose completely.
   C. My Purpose is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise My Purpose.

3. About My Purpose when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. identify values required to nurture talents and abilities,
   B. Learners should ignore My Purpose completely.
   C. My Purpose is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise My Purpose.

5. About Marriage and Family at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the biblical teachings on marriage and family
   B. Learners should ignore Marriage and Family completely.
   C. Marriage and Family is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Marriage and Family.

6. About Marriage and Family at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. discuss the negative results of early marriage,
   B. Learners should ignore Marriage and Family completely.
   C. Marriage and Family is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Marriage and Family.

7. About Marriage and Family when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. identify values needed to avoid early marriage,
   B. Learners should ignore Marriage and Family completely.
   C. Marriage and Family is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Marriage and Family.

9. About Leisure at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the biblical teaching on God’s rest,
   B. Learners should ignore Leisure completely.
   C. Leisure is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Leisure.

10. About Leisure at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. explain biblical teachings on good use of leisure,
   B. Learners should ignore Leisure completely.
   C. Leisure is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Leisure.

11. About Leisure when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. describe how youths misuse leisure time today,
   B. Learners should ignore Leisure completely.
   C. Leisure is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Leisure.

13. About Inspired Word of God at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. explain why the Bible is the inspired word of God,
   B. Learners should ignore Inspired Word of God completely.
   C. Inspired Word of God is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Inspired Word of God.

14. About Inspired Word of God at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. name three authors who wrote the Bible,
   B. Learners should ignore Inspired Word of God completely.
   C. Inspired Word of God is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Inspired Word of God.

15. About Inspired Word of God when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. discuss reasons that led to translation of the Bible into local languages,
   B. Learners should ignore Inspired Word of God completely.
   C. Inspired Word of God is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Inspired Word of God.

17. About The Ten Commandments at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. outline the Ten Commandments and their importance,
   B. Learners should ignore The Ten Commandments completely.
   C. The Ten Commandments is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise The Ten Commandments.

18. About The Ten Commandments at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. identify values and life skills in the Ten Commandments,
   B. Learners should ignore The Ten Commandments completely.
   C. The Ten Commandments is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise The Ten Commandments.

19. About The Ten Commandments when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. outline lessons learnt from the Ten Commandments,
   B. Learners should ignore The Ten Commandments completely.
   C. The Ten Commandments is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise The Ten Commandments.

   C. Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines.

   C. Jacob Wrestles an Angel is only useful outside Kenya.

   A. identify values learnt from the story of Jacob,
   B. Learners should ignore Jacob Wrestles an Angel completely.
   C. Jacob Wrestles an Angel is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Jacob Wrestles an Angel.

33. About The Call of Disciples at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. retell the call of the first disciples as guided by the scriptures,
   B. Learners should ignore The Call of Disciples completely.
   C. The Call of Disciples is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise The Call of Disciples.

34. About The Call of Disciples at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. state how different people are called to serve God today,
   B. Learners should ignore The Call of Disciples completely.
   C. The Call of Disciples is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise The Call of Disciples.

35. About The Call of Disciples when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. retell the call of the first disciples as guided by the scriptures,
   B. Learners should ignore The Call of Disciples completely.
   C. The Call of Disciples is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise The Call of Disciples.

37. About The Temptations of Jesus Christ at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. narrate how Jesus Christ was tempted in the wilderness,
   B. Learners should ignore The Temptations of Jesus Christ completely.
   C. The Temptations of Jesus Christ is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise The Temptations of Jesus Christ.

38. About The Temptations of Jesus Christ at your place of worship, which statement is correct?

   B. Learners should ignore The Temptations of Jesus Christ completely.

   D. There is no need to practise The Temptations of Jesus Christ.

39. About The Temptations of Jesus Christ when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. narrate how Jesus Christ was tempted in the wilderness,
   B. Learners should ignore The Temptations of Jesus Christ completely.
   C. The Temptations of Jesus Christ is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise The Temptations of Jesus Christ.
